description: This file contains helper functions written in shell script that perform various checks and tests related to the 'git read-tree' command. The functions verify whether 'read-tree' succeeds or fails under certain conditions, ensuring that specific flags ('-n', '-u') behave correctly without modifying the index or working tree, and compare pre- and post-operation states using 'git ls-files' and 'git diff-files'.

methods.name: read_tree_must_succeed
methods.description: Checks that 'git read-tree' succeeds without altering the index, comparing states before and after the command.

methods.name: read_tree_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that 'git read-tree' fails as expected, ensuring the index remains unchanged.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Verifies that 'git read-tree -u' succeeds and the working directory state remains consistent with the index.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that 'git read-tree -u' fails as expected, with no changes to index or working directory.
